title: Saban at the Oil Rig

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: These views are something else, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: These views are something else, huh?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: I feel like the sea goes on forever. But maybe it doesn't, you know? I've heard people say there's an edge. Been reading some pretty wild theories recently. What if you get to the end and you just... fall off?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel like the sea goes on forever. But maybe it doesn't, you know? I've heard people say there's an edge. Been reading some pretty wild theories recently. What if you get to the end and you just... fall off?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Believe it or not, you're the first person to say that to me. Most people think I'm pretty happy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Believe it or not, you're the first person to say that to me. Most people think I'm pretty happy.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Okay? I feel better than okay friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay? I feel better than okay friend.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Yes. I feel nothing at all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I feel nothing at all.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Is it? I don't know. I feel like I'm just trying to distract myself. Waste my own time. And now I'm wasting yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it? I don't know. I feel like I'm just trying to distract myself. Waste my own time. And now I'm wasting yours.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Well, I've made a decision recently, and since then, I find nothing really gets me down anymore.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I've made a decision recently, and since then, I find nothing really gets me down anymore.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Safe? What kind of "safe"? Safe in body, or soul?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Safe? What kind of "safe"? Safe in body, or soul?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Oh yeah, don't worry. I got it all figured out. I've almost saved enough money for an android replacement. That's why I'm in such a good mood now!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh yeah, don't worry. I got it all figured out. I've almost saved enough money for an android replacement. That's why I'm in such a good mood now!

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Ah, she knows. She found the receipt from LifeCorp's dispatch message?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, she knows. She found the receipt from LifeCorp's dispatch message?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: I know she saw it - I can see it's marked as read. But she didn't say nothing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know she saw it - I can see it's marked as read. But she didn't say nothing.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: You've seen the view from the docks in the morning when the steam from the Vents catches in the low pressure zone? Stunning. I love that view. I might go check it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You've seen the view from the docks in the morning when the steam from the Vents catches in the low pressure zone? Stunning. I love that view. I might go check it out.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Anyway, I'll see ya around. You take care of yourself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyway, I'll see ya around. You take care of yourself.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: It's not very convincing, but it's good enough. My wife isn't overly fond of me, and my kids are too young to notice the difference.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not very convincing, but it's good enough. My wife isn't overly fond of me, and my kids are too young to notice the difference.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fall off... Nivalis?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fall off... Nivalis?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Fall off the edge of the sea. Maybe you fall to a better place, and the only thing keeping us here is a belief there's nowhere less awful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fall off the edge of the sea. Maybe you fall to a better place, and the only thing keeping us here is a belief there's nowhere less awful.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's an interesting theory.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's an interesting theory.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you okay Saban?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you okay Saban?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's good?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's good?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fall off... the world?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fall off... the world?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You really need to cheer up a bit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You really need to cheer up a bit.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You really need to cheer up a bit.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You really need to cheer up a bit.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Sure. Most people in Nivalis are in some kind of pain. Just look at you. Are you okay friend? Honestly. Can you say that you are happy? Can you say that you are free of pain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Most people in Nivalis are in some kind of pain. Just look at you. Are you okay friend? Honestly. Can you say that you are happy? Can you say that you are free of pain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If I'm honest, I feel pretty numb too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I'm honest, I feel pretty numb too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If I'm honest, I feel pretty numb too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If I'm honest, I feel pretty numb too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Saban are you going to do something you'll regret?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Saban are you going to do something you'll regret?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Saban are you going to do something you'll regret?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Saban are you going to do something you'll regret?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am okay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am okay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel happiness AND pain. That's life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel happiness AND pain. That's life.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I feel happiness AND pain. That's life.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I feel happiness AND pain. That's life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Saban are you able to keep yourself safe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Saban are you able to keep yourself safe?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Saban are you able to keep yourself safe?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Saban are you able to keep yourself safe?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: I won't be around to regret it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I won't be around to regret it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can talk to me Saban.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can talk to me Saban.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can talk to me Saban.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can talk to me Saban.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: I ain't hiding anything. Not from you anyway. I got plans to end it all. I've had enough. I've made my peace. See no reason to stick around...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ain't hiding anything. Not from you anyway. I got plans to end it all. I've had enough. I've made my peace. See no reason to stick around...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's not the answer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not the answer.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... I have all the things you're SUPPOSED to want. A decent job, a home, money for decent food, a wife and family.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, I don't know... I have all the things you're SUPPOSED to want. A decent job, a home, money for decent food, a wife and family.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's life. Nothing you can do about it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's life. Nothing you can do about it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's life. Nothing you can do about it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's life. Nothing you can do about it?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: It's play the game, or cash out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's play the game, or cash out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You have plenty to live for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You have plenty to live for.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You have plenty to live for.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You have plenty to live for.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What about your family?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What about your family?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're replacing yourself with an android?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're replacing yourself with an android?!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're replacing yourself with an android?!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're replacing yourself with an android?!

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: It will be more of ... well, I've asked the LifeCorp personal android replacement service to make some improvements on my existing personality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It will be more of ... well, I've asked the LifeCorp personal android replacement service to make some improvements on my existing personality.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You need to cheer up buddy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You need to cheer up buddy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You need to cheer up buddy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You need to cheer up buddy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Improvements?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Improvements?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Sure. I've been pretty checked-out for a while now. You know, struggle to get out of bed... can't concentrate. This new Saban - technically - doesn't' even need to sleep! Though it will, just so no one feels too weird about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. I've been pretty checked-out for a while now. You know, struggle to get out of bed... can't concentrate. This new Saban - technically - doesn't' even need to sleep! Though it will, just so no one feels too weird about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What will you tell your wife?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What will you tell your wife?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What will you tell your wife?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What will you tell your wife?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Oh...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Yeah, pretty clear. She thinks it's an upgrade too, I guess. She's not wrong. When I realized she agreed with my plan to be replaced... well it made everything real easy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, pretty clear. She thinks it's an upgrade too, I guess. She's not wrong. When I realized she agreed with my plan to be replaced... well it made everything real easy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You don't have to go through with this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You don't have to go through with this.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You don't have to go through with this.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You don't have to go through with this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you even listening to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you even listening to me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you even listening to me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you even listening to me?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Sure, sure. Don't you worry about it. After all, what is it to you? You're just another person who will forget about me in five minutes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, sure. Don't you worry about it. After all, what is it to you? You're just another person who will forget about me in five minutes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's lots of things to see in this city. Lots to do. People who care about you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's lots of things to see in this city. Lots to do. People who care about you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: There's lots of things to see in this city. Lots to do. People who care about you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: There's lots of things to see in this city. Lots to do. People who care about you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: When will you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When will you do it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I won't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I won't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Saban.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Saban.

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: But none of it makes me feel anything. They sold me on a life, and when I got it, I didn't want it. I want a refund, but you don't get those on your life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But none of it makes me feel anything. They sold me on a life, and when I got it, I didn't want it. I want a refund, but you don't get those on your life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I sense you have a plan?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I sense you have a plan?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I sense you have a plan?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I sense you have a plan?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You still have responsibilities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You still have responsibilities.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your family gets an upgrade?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your family gets an upgrade?

nodes.speaker: Saban Greggs
nodes.text: Set a timer. Go ahead. Maybe... 15 minutes. Set a timer, and when it goes off, see if you're still thinking about me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Set a timer. Go ahead. Maybe... 15 minutes. Set a timer, and when it goes off, see if you're still thinking about me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure I will.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure I will.
